criteria.name: Adherence to Assignment Guidelines and Focus
criteria.feedback: Your essay clearly addresses the impact of technology and stays on topic, but it is shorter than a typical brief essay. To receive full points in the future, try to expand your ideas and include more details or examples.

criteria.name: Clarity and Precision of Writing
criteria.feedback: Your writing is generally clear and concise, but some phrases—like "many areas" and "everyday tasks"—could be more specific for greater precision. To improve, try adding more concrete details or examples.

criteria.name: Content Accuracy and Relevance
criteria.feedback: Your essay accurately identifies major areas impacted by technology, but lacks specific examples or precise explanations, making the content too general. For a higher score, include more detailed and precise analysis of technology's impact in each area you discuss.

criteria.name: Grammar, Punctuation, and Mechanics
criteria.feedback: Your writing demonstrates excellent grammar, punctuation, and spelling, resulting in clear and highly readable sentences. Great job maintaining strong mechanics throughout your essay!

criteria.name: Organization and Coherence
criteria.feedback: Your essay shows some basic structure with a title and opening idea, but is limited to a single paragraph with no clear transitions or conclusion. To improve organization and coherence, try developing separate paragraphs for each section and adding transitions and a summary ending.
